scope: Independent postselection audit of saved genuine held-out fields; no fitting or model selection. No emulator training/evaluation helper imported. Full-complex-FFT spectra and independent vectorized first-exit ray traversal.

MFP_settings.phase_origin_sampling: same uniform voxel-rank, subvoxel-position and direction variates; origins differ for unequal phase masks
MFP_settings.interpretation: geometric first-exit lengths with cap censoring, not physical absorption mean-free-path; same redshift, potentially different neutral fractions
